development: All 12 earlier CAVIAR takes, including the former holdout, are now development data. Their previous scores remain historical and are not called held out again.
selection: Highest identity-verified event F1 on the three new validation takes, then development F1, then fewer unverified validation events; prefer fewer suppression rules on ties. Freeze settings/code/source hashes before reading new holdout reference activities or detector outcomes.
scoring: Keep prior identity-verified event rule unchanged: direction matches, <=3 seconds timing difference, >=3 one-to-one box associations at IoU>=0.3 to published human ID. Original one-second rule is secondary. No ambiguous-event exclusion.
reference_method: Use published hand-labeled shop-enter/exit intervals; choose human footpoint nearest source doorway y=145 during interval; visually inspect before detector outcomes for each split. New holdout reference review is gated until settings are frozen. Retain crossings outside any proposed counting segment.

fixes.geometry: Use complete doorway segment x=205..335 at y=145; no detector crop; three-pixel deadband, 0.12-second confirmation, 0.6-second maximum gap, 1.2-second track expiration, person start threshold 0.4.

limitations: Same legacy 384x288 indoor camera/day and some actors; new takes, not a new location or modern outdoor-camera validation.
Public pretrained model training overlap is unknown.
Geometric duplicate suppression may also remove strongly occluded real people; evaluate groups and pass-by negatives explicitly.
No face, appearance or biometric identification. Evaluation uses published anonymous IDs only.
